notes.title: Forgotten Fragments is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Sphericals![/b][/h3][p]Happy release day! After months of hard work, [i]Forgotten Fragments[/i] is finally here. This game has truly been a project of the heart for our small team, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎥 Don’t miss the [b]release trailer[/b], it gives you a first look at the adventure that awaits:[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="3UfVA2HWdQY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]What’s inside?[/h3][list][*][p][b]Two campaigns, two stories[/b] – enjoy the single-player journey or team up in the dedicated co-op campaign[/p][/*][*][p][b]Over 120 handcrafted levels[/b] spread across 4 worlds (combined number for singleplayer and co-op)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenging boss battles[/b] that test your puzzle-solving and platforming skills[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secrets & collectibles[/b] to unlock hidden levels and character skins[/p][/*][/list][p]👾 [b]Fun fact:[/b] During development, we had some brave interns playtest the entire co-op campaign… and they racked up [b]3,643 deaths[/b] in the process. Think you and your partner can do better?[/p][hr][/hr][h3]We can’t wait to see you dive in. Have fun, share your feedback, and know that we’re just as excited as you are to finally launch this adventure.[/h3][h3]💛 From all of us: thank you for being here on day one.[/h3][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]✨ Check out these bundles![/b]
Don’t miss our special Steam bundles to grab [i]Forgotten Fragments[/i] alongside other great indie titles at a discount.[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59664/Forgotten_Fragments__Lost_Twins_2/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59766/Forgotten_Fragments__Symphonia/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59688/Forgotten_Fragments__Brave_Escape/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Forgotten Fragments launches September 24!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Sphericals![/b][/h3][h3]The wait is almost over! We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Forgotten Fragments[/b] will officially launch on [b]September 24[/b]. [/h3][p][/p][p]Join Enid, Ryder, and Dayen on their journey to recover the lost fragments in a charming pixel art world filled with puzzles, secrets, and epic challenges.[/p][p]To celebrate the release date, we’ve also prepared a [b]brand-new trailer.[/b] Showcasing the adventure, the worlds you’ll explore, and the trials that lie ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]🎥 [b]Watch the new trailer now and get ready for launch day![/b][/p][previewyoutube="714c9RT_gvc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]What Awaits You in Forgotten Fragments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Two campaigns, two stories[/b] – play solo or team up with a friend in the dedicated co-op campaign[/p][/*][*][p][b]Over 120 handcrafted levels[/b] across 4 unique worlds [/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenging boss fights[/b] that put your skills to the test[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hidden collectibles and secret levels[/b] to uncover[/p][/*][*][p][b]Atmospheric pixel art & captivating soundtrack[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]See you on September 24 — don’t forget to wishlist [i]Forgotten Fragments[/i] so you won’t miss the adventure! [/b][/p][p][b]...and also, it helps us a lot! <3[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]- The Binary Phoenix Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492090/Forgotten_Fragments/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Play the new demo | Steam Next Fest is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The wait is over, explorers! As [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] kicks off, we're thrilled to finally share the playable [b]Forgotten Fragments[/b] demo with thousands of players around the world.[/p][p]Whether you're diving in [b]solo[/b] or [b]teaming up with a friend[/b], the demo has something for every kind of adventurer:[/p][p][/p][h3]🧩 [b]1 Player Mode[/b]: 10 levels + 3 secret levels + hidden collectibles
🧩 [b]2 Player Mode[/b]: 10 levels + 4 secret levels + hidden collectibles[/h3][p][/p][p]Step into the fractured world of [b]Forgotten Fragments[/b]! Each level is handcrafted with [b]secrets to uncover[/b] and fragments to find—[b]either alone or side by side in local co-op[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="FdVpahikB_M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We’re truly happy to share that we’ve [b]partnered[/b] with the amazing team at [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/AssembleEntertainment"][b]Assemble Entertainment[/b][/url]! 🎉They’re supporting us on the publishing side and helping us grow [b]Forgotten Fragments[/b] into the best and most complete version it can be. We’re eager to continue this journey together and [b]see the game flourish[/b] even more in the months ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]And we can't be more excited to be [b]part of Steam Next Fest[/b] and to [b]hear what you think[/b]. If you enjoy the demo, we’d be [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1498080/Forgotten_Fragments_Demo/"]super grateful if you left a short review[/url][/b]—your feedback and support [b]mean the world[/b] and help us tremendously on our development journey.[/p][p][b]Thank you for playing and being part of the adventure![/b] 💛[/p][p]— The [i]Forgotten Fragments[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Forgotten Fragments Demo Update
notes.notes:
We just released an update to Forgotten Fragments Demo!

[b]Version 0.8.2 Changelog[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031685/538a4c5856610f90aeaced0f6b3ac8d95a7d8aa0.png[/img]

[b]Features[/b]
- Added a short trajectory prediction to make aiming more accurate.
- Added extra visuals and SFX for the sphere aiming,
- Added "Assist Mode" toggle: modify the game rules to your liking (more sphere time, see the sphere trajectory, disable dangers...),

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031685/c98cd5766c9d0219cb02a82a0e79d1b0b008d6c9.png[/img]

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Added support for all frame rates. Before, it was capped to 60Hz and was making 120Hz and above have some lag when moving or aiming with the sphere.
- Migrated the project from Unity 2019 to 2022, The game runs smoother than before.

Thank you for your support and we hope you continue enjoying Forgotten Fragments!

If you like the Demo, you will help us a lot by wishlisting the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492090/Forgotten_Fragments/

notes.title: Forgotten Fragments Demo Update
notes.notes:
We just released an update to Forgotten Fragments Demo!

[b]Version 0.6.0 Changelog[/b]

[b]Features[/b]
- Added Lynn sleep state (if you don’t interact with her for a while)
- Changed “Drop Box” distance so it falls in front of the player
- Updated some levels to improve readability of levers/switches
- Updated credits roll
- Shortened dialogs with Lynn for the Singleplayer campaign
- Added Ryder “Idle fun” animation (if you don't interact with the game for a while)

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Removed crow sounds during intro phrases
- Fixed soft lock when pressing “restart” button while changing areas of level selectors
- Fixed jumping on spikes and not dying
- Visual correction on level complete panel when obtaining a secret scroll

[b]NOTICE[/b]
Due to some internal changes, your Demo progress could be reset. To recover your save files follow this instructions:
1 - Go to [b]C:\Users\<YOUR_USER>\AppData\LocalLow\Binary Phoenix\Forgotten Fragments 0.5.5 Demo[/b]
2 - Copy everything
3 - Go to [b]C:\Users\<YOUR_USER>\AppData\LocalLow\Binary Phoenix\Forgotten Fragments Demo[/b] (the folder will be created once you run the new Demo version)
4 - Paste and replace everything
5 - Continue your adventure!

Thank you for your support and we hope you continue enjoying Forgotten Fragments!

If you like the Demo, you will help us a lot by wishlisting the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492090/Forgotten_Fragments/

notes.title: We’ll be at Indie Dev Day + Tokyo Game Show
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This year, we're once again attending Indie Dev Day, the video game event taking place at La Farga (Barcelona) from tomorrow, September 27, until the 29th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031685/a5b55c849cc0ecdd66fb22dac04daeac33c49f8b.jpg[/img]

At this event, you’ll be able to try the extended demo of Forgotten Fragments, which includes the first world's final boss.

And that’s not all! We're also part of this year's Steam event at Tokyo Game Show. We hope more people get a chance to try the demo during these days, so if you haven’t done it yet, this could be a great time!

If you enjoy the game, [b]please add it to your Steam wishlist[/b]: it would help us a lot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492090/Forgotten_Fragments/

notes.title: We’re at Gamescom! If you’re in Cologne, stop by and say hello
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Our last summer event is here, and we’ll have a booth at the IndieArenaBooth at Gamescom in Cologne, and we will be participating in the Steam Event with the same name.

It will be running from August 20 to 26. If you're at Gamescom and want to stop by, give us your feedback, or try out an extended demo, you’re more than welcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031685/5a02dd28ab3f5604456289d63eaf57cca0e5f7d2.jpg[/img]

We’ve decided to keep the demo active after the event because we want everyone to have the chance to try out Forgotten Fragments.

As always, if you enjoy the game, adding it to your wishlist would really help us out.

notes.title: We are at the Tiny Teams Fest + Demo available!

Hello everyone! We are entering the final stretch of the development of Forgotten Fragments, and we have a summer full of festivals ahead.
